item.description:

  • 英語名: Idol Project Producer Nogami Yuuki no Ura Manual

あらすじ

One day while returning from the convenience store, protagonist Yuuki Nogami is hit by a car.

The injury is minor, but an altercation with the sleazy driver turns into a hit-and-run, with Yuuki holding a business card and a grudge. He decides to go to the company on the card to seek damages, but when he shows the card, a case of mistaken identity turns Yuuki into an idol producer!
